ADD-03/cover/para3.note: Bidders shall acknowledge receipt in Form 4-A

ADD-03/Q15.note: Q15 response restates that Volume I Clause 8.9 is replaced by Section 2.1 and that an undertaking is accepted only from a member described in Section 2.4, which shall give its own undertaking (not the lead member on its behalf).

ADD-03/Q17.note: Q17 response confirms that Volume V Clause 44.2 (arbitration conducted in the English language) applies.

ADD-03/3.1.new_text: The treated effluent storage reservoir referred to in Clause 1.2 shall provide a working volume of not less than six (6) hours of the design flow and shall be divided into not fewer than two (2) compartments, each capable of being isolated for cleaning while the other remains in service.

ADD-03/4.2.note: The period of sixty (60) days in Volume V Clause 39.4 is unchanged.

ADD-03/disp/cover/para1.reason: The issue-date line 'Issued 18 November 2026' states the Addendum's date of issue (the stage date). It amends, obliges and excepts nothing.

ADD-03/disp/cover/para2.reason: Title line 'Tender NUPA/ISTP/2026/014' under the heading 'ADDENDUM NO. 3'. It identifies the tender and amends, obliges and excepts nothing.

ADD-03/disp/1.1.reason: Recital: 'This Addendum is issued under Volume I Clause 5.3 and takes precedence over Addenda Nos. 1 and 2 in accordance with Volume I Clause 3.2.' It restates the existing order in VOL-I:3.2(a), '(a) the Addenda, a later Addendum prevailing over an earlier one;', and amends neither 5.3 nor 3.2. A person confirms; which provision prevails in any particular conflict remains a person's decision.

ADD-03/disp/1.2.reason: Interpretation rule for the Addendum's own references: 'A reference in this Addendum to a Clause, Table or Form is to that Clause, Table or Form as amended by Addenda Nos. 1 and 2, unless otherwise stated.' It amends no volume unit and imposes no bidder obligation. It matches reading every target at previous_stage ADD-02. The 'unless otherwise stated' exception operates only where a later provision says otherwise; that is assessed in the batch owning that provision. A person confirms.

ADD-03/disp/1.3.reason: Recital of fact: 'Clarification requests 15 to 19 were received before the time stated in Volume I Clause 5.2.' It amends, obliges and excepts nothing, and leaves VOL-I:5.2 unchanged. Its difference from the cover's '15 to 20' is raised separately as issue ADD-03/issue/cq20 for a person.

ADD-03/Q18-disp.reason: The response only cross-refers: 'See new Volume II Clause 4.6, inserted by Section 3.1 of this Addendum.' It prints no change, obligation or exception of its own and leaves Volume II Clause 1.2 as it stands; the capacity requirement is inserted by Section 3.1 (ADD-03:3.1), dealt with in another batch. A person confirms.

ADD-03/Q19-disp.reason: The response only cross-refers: 'Yes. See Section 4 of this Addendum.' It prints no change, obligation or exception of its own; the change to Volume V Clause 39.4 is made by Section 4.1 (ADD-03:4.1), dealt with in another batch. A person confirms.

ADD-03/AppA/para1.reason: The paragraph introduces the reproduction of the Office's letter and Table 8-1 ("The following letter and table are reproduced as issued by the Northern Region Investment Services Office under its reference No. 228/2026 dated 16 November 2026.") and restates a precedence already made by Section 2.2 ("The Arabic text governs in accordance with Section 2.2 of this Addendum."; ADD-03:2.2 prints "The Arabic text governs."). It names no volume unit and prints no old/new pair, deletion or obligation of its own; Table 8-1's incorporation and precedence are dealt with under ADD-03:2.2 and ADD-03:T8-1. A person confirms that this restatement changes nothing.

ADD-03/AppA/para2.reason: The paragraph reads only "End of reproduction.": it marks the end of the reproduced letter and table in Appendix A, names no unit and prints no change, obligation or exception.

ADD-03/AppB/para1:disp.reason: The paragraph introduces a convenience translation and amends no volume unit. It prints 'This translation is provided for convenience only. The Arabic text of Table 8-1 at Appendix A governs.' The letter particulars it restates (reference No. 228/2026, dated 16 November 2026, to the Authority, subject and tender number) match the governing Arabic letterhead on the crop of ADD-03:p3-image. A person confirms.

ADD-03/AppB/para2:disp.reason: This translates the Arabic qualifier of Table 8-1 and amends no unit. The translation is non-governing: ADD-03:AppB/para1 prints 'This translation is provided for convenience only. The Arabic text of Table 8-1 at Appendix A governs.' The governing words are the Arabic qualifier of ADD-03:p3-image, which is handled in another batch. A person confirms.

ADD-03/T8-1/1:disp.reason: This is the convenience translation of row 1 of Table 8-1. The word 'required' appears only in the translated column heading 'Documents required with the application: Certified commercial registration'. That is a rendering of the governing Arabic row ADD-03:p3-image/r1 (handled in another batch), not an operative requirement of its own. ADD-03:2.2 prints 'The Arabic text governs. The English translation at Appendix B is provided for convenience only.' The governing row's issue period ٣ matches the translation's 'Issue period (Working Days): 3'. A person confirms.

ADD-03/T8-1/2:disp.reason: This is the convenience translation of row 2 of Table 8-1. The word 'required' appears only in the translated column heading 'Documents required with the application: Commercial registration and audited financial statements for the last financial year, certified'. That is a rendering of the governing Arabic row ADD-03:p3-image/r2, not an operative requirement of its own. ADD-03:2.2 prints 'The Arabic text governs. The English translation at Appendix B is provided for convenience only.' Its 'Issue period (Working Days): 3' does NOT match the governing Arabic 'مدة الإصدار (أيام عمل): ٥', so the 3 must not be used as the row 2 period. The discrepancy is raised as issue ADD-03/T8-1/2:issue and draft question ADD-03/T8-1/2:q. A person confirms.

ADD-03/T8-1/3:disp.reason: This is the convenience translation of row 3 of Table 8-1. The word 'required' appears only in the translated column heading 'Documents required with the application: Branch registration certificate and parent company board resolution authorising the branch'. That is a rendering of the governing Arabic row ADD-03:p3-image/r3 (handled in another batch), not an operative requirement of its own. ADD-03:2.2 prints 'The English translation at Appendix B is provided for convenience only.' The governing row's issue period ٨ matches the translation's 'Issue period (Working Days): 8'. A person confirms.

ADD-03/T8-1/notes:disp.reason: This is a heading only ('Notes to Table 8-1:') in the convenience translation and amends nothing. ADD-03:2.2 prints 'The English translation at Appendix B is provided for convenience only.' A person confirms.

ADD-03/T8-1/note(1):disp.reason: This is the convenience translation of Note 1 (the counting rule) and amends no unit. ADD-03:AppB/para1 prints 'This translation is provided for convenience only. The Arabic text of Table 8-1 at Appendix A governs.' The governing counting rule is the Arabic note ADD-03:p3-image/note1 (handled in another batch), which Clause 2.3 applies ('counted in accordance with the Notes to Table 8-1'). A person confirms.

ADD-03/T8-1/note(2):disp.reason: This is the convenience translation of Note 2 (90-day certificate validity) and amends no unit. ADD-03:2.2 prints 'The English translation at Appendix B is provided for convenience only.' The governing note is ADD-03:p3-image/note2 (handled in another batch), which prints ٩٠, matching the translation's ninety (90). A person confirms.

ADD-03/T8-1/note(3):disp.reason: This is the convenience translation of Note 3. Its words restrict ('through the Office's portal only'; 'complete only when all the documents listed above are attached'), but it is not the operative text. ADD-03:AppB/para1 prints 'This translation is provided for convenience only. The Arabic text of Table 8-1 at Appendix A governs.' Any obligation arises from the governing Arabic note ADD-03:p3-image/note3, handled in another batch. A person confirms.

ADD-03/AppB/para3:disp.reason: This is the translated signature block of the Office's letter and amends nothing. ADD-03:2.2 prints 'The English translation at Appendix B is provided for convenience only.' The signatory line matches the Arabic 'مدير مكتب خدمات الاستثمار بالمنطقة الشمالية'. The translation says '(signature and stamp)', but on the crop the stamp area is an empty oval outline, and its reading (ADD-03:p3-image/stamp) carries no text. Whether the stamp is properly applied is noted for Document control; it is not decided here. A person confirms.

ADD-03/3.2.reason: The provision states "The insertion of Clause 4.6 does not renumber any other Clause of Volume II." It prints no old/new pair, deletion or obligation; it confirms that the existing Volume II clause numbers stand after op ADD-03/3.1 (new 4.6 placed after 4.5; no Volume II Clause 4.6 existed at ADD-02). A person confirms the no_effect.
